evidenceState.glp1ProcedureReconciliation: The 2024 multisociety guidance supports individualized shared decision-making and risk stratification rather than a universal hold. Current product labels for tirzepatide, Amneal exenatide, and Foundayo preserve delayed-gastric-emptying/aspiration provenance and state that available data are insufficient to determine whether modified fasting or temporary discontinuation mitigates risk. PREP-MEDS therefore retains review-only routing and no universal autonomous hold interval.
